Tooltip_LastPurpose_TrophyKnoxIngot: An ingot from the Knox Bank vault, the date of the job scratched into it by hand. The first of the collection.
Tooltip_LastPurpose_TrophyCrimsonLady: The canvas nobody got out in time, still in its gilded frame. Worth more as a keepsake than on the market.
Tooltip_LastPurpose_TrophyPenthouseGoble: The gold goblet from the businessman's study. He drank from it until the very last day.
